# Hush

> Hush is a private macOS writing tool that turns speech into polished text using local transcription and local AI.

Hush is designed so dictated content and AI refinement stay on the user's Mac. It works across Mac apps, supports reusable writing personas, and lets a user publish an optional encrypted proof link for a message.

Hush proof links describe signed capture origin and refinement history. They do not prove biological identity or determine whether spoken audio was AI-generated. Proof contents are encrypted, require the private key in the URL fragment, and are intentionally excluded from public discovery.

## Product

- [Hush](https://behu.sh/): Product overview, privacy model, features, and macOS experience.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://behu.sh/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages intended for search indexing.
